meta.title: fix(website): Remove Google Fonts caching and add JS files caching in VitePWA
meta.body_summary: Remove unused Google Fonts caching and add NetworkFirst caching for JS files in VitePWA configuration to fix stale JS updates.

perf_labels.notes: Devin removed unused Google Fonts cache and added NetworkFirst for JS; maintainer amended with broader cache rules and merged in ~21 min without formal review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 34 changed lines in a single config file, this is a tiny, low-risk editing. It fits a fast-turnaround configuration fix and is consistent with the maintainer merging after appending their own amendments.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review text exists, but the maintainer’s follow‑up commits indicate that the initial Devin solution was insufficient: more resource types (fonts, images) and higher maxAgeSeconds were added.
review_details.performance_claim: JS files will update properly when changed, improving website load performance for returning visitors.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A small VitePWA configuration change is easily within Devin’s reach, but the agent’s initial solution was incomplete; maintainer extended the caching rules directly.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer yamadashy reviewed the VitePWA config and directly committed two fixes to expand caching rules and adjust async attribute.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after caching performance data; changes are purely configuration‑based.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer added commits to change GTM script async attribute and to include fonts, images, and other resources in the cache, plus increased maxAgeSeconds.

core_change_summary.description: In website/client/.vitepress/config/configShard.ts, removed Google Fonts caching configuration and added NetworkFirst strategy for JavaScript files; maintainer later added additional resource types (fonts, images, etc.) and increased cache lifetime.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes are confined to the single Vitepress configuration file.
